design_timing: exploratory definition selected after inspecting pilot results

label_definitions.0: STAY has better observed packet performance
label_definitions.1: HANDOVER has better observed packet performance
label_definitions.-1: tie or incomplete observation; exclude from fitting

training_source_requirement: archived simulator source SHA256 verified by intake
limitations: This is a separate, narrower objective than the draft service-failure-first protocol.
A packet preference is not evidence of better connectivity, radio outage or end-to-end loss.
Labels reflect realized paired outcomes, not an expectation over channel/RNG conditions.
Repeated/conflicting inputs must remain together; no random row split.
No independent validation/test evidence is currently available.
